tournaments.title: NEXUSX ARENA CLASH – SOLO 1V1
tournaments.description:
NEXUSX ARENA CLASH – SOLO 1V1

ENTER THE ARENA. PROVE YOUR SKILLS. DOMINATE!

TOURNAMENT INFORMATION

Game: BGMI

Game Mode: Team Deathmatch (TDM)

Map: Warehouse

Perspective: TPP

Format: SOLO 1V1

Match Format: Best of 3

Maximum Rounds: 3

MATCH SYSTEM

Two players compete against each other.

First player to win 2 rounds wins the match.

Third round is played only when the score is 1–1.

WEAPON RULE

Each player must use their selected weapon throughout the match.

Weapon switching is prohibited.

IMPORTANT INFORMATION

Use your registered BGMI account.

Join at the officially confirmed reporting time.

Do not share room credentials with unauthorized players.

Glitches, exploits and unfair gameplay are prohibited.

Rule violations may result in disqualification.

REGISTRATION

Use the official SOLO 1V1 registration form.

NEXUSX ESPORTS INDIA
PLAY. COMPETE. DOMINATE.
